episode.title: This GIANT HIPPOPOTAMUS Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a minimal studio jungle set, a colossal hippopotamus takes a performer into its cavernous jaws, then the crew force its practical jaws open and he steps out unharmed.

shots.prompt:
ONE CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN TAKE. The camera is low and close, so the giant creature fills the whole frame from the very first second, its head and jaws reaching past the edges of the picture. One dark production element stays at the bottom edge of the frame, an out-of-focus crew head or the corner of a camera rig or a flight case, and the blue screen wall with its pale blue cross tracking markers sits far behind the creature and reads out of focus, so the shot still reads as a film set. A shallow depth of field keeps the creature's head sharp while everything behind it falls away. A hard directional lamp rakes the creature from one side and lays real shadows, while the space behind the creature stays darker than the creature itself. One giant creature faces exactly one man. The creature's jaws open wide and close over him until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth. Crew members rush in, put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and in the final seconds the same one man climbs out onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal. The camera stays close and handheld throughout, drifting with the action, with natural motion blur.

A colossal hippopotamus with slate-grey rubbery hide, tiny amber eyes, massive ivory canine tusks and a height of four metres looms over the studio jungle set. Ihsan stands on a patch of earth in a khaki field shirt, keeping calm eye contact with the towering beast. The immense pink mouth gapes wide and descends over Ihsan, engulfing him completely within the dark interior. Stagehands dressed in dark attire rush onto the set, grasp the weighted jaws with both hands, and heave them open. In the final seconds, Ihsan climbs out onto the concrete stage floor unharmed. Ambient sound only: footsteps on earth, studio air handling and crew movement.
shots.violation_observation: The giant hippopotamus's mouth closes over the man until his whole body is hidden inside it, then crew members put their hands on the giant hippopotamus and force its mouth open, and the same man climbs out onto the set floor.

first_comment: Would you stand this close to a giant hippo mouth?

object_card.name: giant hippopotamus
object_card.descriptor: A colossal hippopotamus with slate-grey rubbery hide, tiny amber eyes, massive ivory canine tusks and a height of four metres.
object_card.framing: A handheld camera stays low and close while pushing in slowly so the giant hippopotamus fills the whole frame from the first second, keeping its massive snout sharp while an out-of-focus camera monitor stays at the lower edge and the blue screen falls away.
object_card.anomaly_descriptor: Crew members rush forward to grip the rubbery upper lip and heave the counterweighted mechanical jaws apart by hand.
